data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

words.word: Although it was raining, we went out.
Although it was raining but we went out.
Although is because.
She stayed home because she was ill.
She stayed home because of she was ill.
Because is a noun.
We will go unless it rains.
We will go unless it will rain.
Unless means always.
He likes tea, whereas she prefers coffee.
He likes tea whereas but she prefers coffee.
Whereas is a place.
She spoke quietly so that no one heard.
She spoke quietly so that to no one heard.
So that means although.
Finish your work before you leave.
Finish your work before to leave.
Before is future.
She has lived here since 2020.
She lives here since three years.
Since means tomorrow.
I like the job, though it is stressful.
I like the job though but it is stressful.
Though is a verb.
She was reading while he
